tweet.text:
The @StateNavigate forecasts have been updated tonight to remove Wedgewood's polls from our Governor forecasts. Not much has changed anywhere. NE w/the largest margin change at 1.1%. Everything else 0.1%-0.3%.

GA, IA, KS, MI, NE, NV, OH, TX, WI are the states where there were Wedgewood polls in our forecasts. All are out now.
